detail.longDescription: I am attempting to follow the instructions here that indicate I should be able to just do FROM postgres:17 COPY --from=ghcr.io/pglayers/pgx-pgvector:17 / / COPY --from=ghcr.io/pglayers/pgx-postgis:17 / / COPY --from=ghcr.io/pglayers/pgx-pg_cron:17 / / and then CREATE EXTENSION and then offers no instruction on what needs to be done. I have seen some references that the layers being there are not sufficient to get this to work and this appears to be the case. How do I go about doing this? There are some sources that indicate I need to add the libraries to the postgresql.conf file.
